title: Compute GBG function and verify limits
action: Implement the Gaussian-broadened Gaussian (GBG) static zero-field Kubo-Toyabe relaxation function G_z^GBG(t; Δ_eff, R) using the closed-form expression involving Δ_eff and R. For Δ_eff = 1, compute the function at time points t = 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0 for R = 0 and R = 1. Determine whether the R=0 values match the standard Gaussian Kubo-Toyabe function G_z^G(t) with rms width Δ = 1, and whether the R=1 sequence is monotonic non-increasing. Write the results to results.json.
description: JSON file containing the computed GBG values for both R=0 and R=1, and two boolean assertions about their properties.
output_schema: object with keys: R0_values (list of [t, Gz] pairs for 11 time points), R1_values (list of [t, Gz] pairs for 11 time points), R0_matches_Gaussian (bool), R1_monotonic (bool). All Gz values are floats.
